item.title: 🔵 FBI warns of Kali365 phishing service targeting Microsoft 365 accounts
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
The FBI is warning about the Kali365 phishing-as-a-service platform (PhaaS) that is used to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts by abusing OAuth device code authentication to steal session tokens and bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA). [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 3h ago

item.title: 🔵 Ghostwriter Targets Ukraine Government Entities with Prometheus Phishing Malware
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
